name: jira
description: Jira Cloud integration — channel, workflows, and tools

tools.name: jira
tools.description: Jira toolset master switch — every jira_* tool additionally requires its own key

tools.name: jira_search
tools.description: Search Jira issues by text in summary

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Read one Jira issue with comments and attachments

tools.name: jira_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Jira issue (PUBLIC on Jira Service Management portals)

tools.name: jira_transition_issue
tools.description: Move a Jira issue to another workflow status

tools.name: jira_assign_issue
tools.description: Assign a Jira issue to a user

tools.name: jira_attach_file
tools.description: Upload a file attachment to a Jira issue

tools.name: jira_update_issue
tools.description: Update fields on an existing Jira issue

tools.name: jira_get_attachment
tools.description: Download a single Jira attachment by ID on demand (bypasses the jira_get_issue download limit)
